title: Monkeypox Virus
subtitle: Kit de détection par PCR temps réel
description: (Monkeypox virus clades I et II) Validé par le CNR Orthopovirus

content.title: All clades detected
content.text: Qualitative detection of Monkeypox virus (clades Ia, Ib and II).

content.title: Clinically validated
content.text: By the National Reference Center-LE Orthopovirus (France)

content.title: Adaptable and easy to use
content.text: Quick and easy to use, transportable at room temperature, edaptable to various thermocyclers.

content.title: qPCR Duplex
content.text: MPOX virus specific DNA (F3L, B7R and G2R) and an endogenous internal control targeting a human housekeeping gene, both targets detected in a single well.

title: Éruptions cutanées fébriles
subtitle: Kit de diagnostic différentiel par PCR-HRM
description: (Monkeypox virus, virus Herpes simplex de type 1/2, et virus Varicelle-Zona)

content.title: Syndromic diagnosis
content.text: Identification of the main viruses responsibles for febrile rash eruptions.

content.title: Multiplex qPCR HRM
content.text: MPOX virus, VZV, HSV-1, HSV-2, and an endogenous internal control are detected in a single well.

content.title: Adaptable and easy to use
content.text: Easy to use and fast (1 hour post-extraction), transportable at room temperature (freeze fried), adaptable to different thermocyclers (MIC, CFX96, QS5).

content.title: Automated interpretation
content.text: The obtained results are then analyzed by an artificial intelligence-based software: DISoft.

content.title: Clinically validated
content.text: Clinical validation of the DIRASH kit in collaboration with the Montpellier University Hospital (CHU) and the National Institude of Biomedical Research (INRB).
